listing.description: Charming Tiny-Home Retreat on 2.85± Acres - Turnkey and Tranquil. Here's your chance to own a custom tiny home set on a serene 2.85± acre parcel with gentle, rolling topography-perfect for peaceful mornings and starry nights. Utilities are ready to go: shared well, septic, and power are in place. The furnished tiny home features two cozy upper sleeping lofts, a bright living space, and an outdoor cooking area for al fresco meals. Inside you'll find a small fridge, kitchen sink, living space and a full bathroom with a walk-in shower. A separate shed houses the included washer and dryer and offers extra storage for gear and tools. Outdoor furniture is included-just bring your toothbrush. Highlights: 2.85± acres with soft, scenic contours; Turnkey and furnished; Two upper sleeping lofts; Outdoor cooking area + indoor sink and fridge; Bathroom with walk-in shower; Shed with washer, dryer, and storage; Shared well, septic, and power in place; Outdoor furniture included. A sweet weekend escape, minimalist full-time living, or a nature-lover's landing spot-this property invites you to slow down and savor the simple life.

verdict: A genuinely charming, bargain-priced, turnkey furnished tiny-home retreat on 2.85 oak-dotted acres with direct sunset views — that fails the buyer's hard 3-hour gate (OSRM 3h59m free-flow, realistically 4h+) and is a tiny house on wheels on pier jacks with a rural DIY-ish utility stack (shared well, storage tanks, generator). The trade-off this property IS: near-perfect land + price + turnkey package, offset by distance from SF and unconventional title/systems diligence.
